name: Высокий дуб
subject: A very TALL slender oak with a long visible dark-brown cuboid trunk and THREE vertically separated stepped foliage tiers: largest lower tier, narrower middle tier and small top tuft; overall narrow column/pyramid silhouette. Forest-green fused leaf blocks with broad warm olive pixel accents, a few chunky side branch ends visible between tiers. Root stubs are trunk components only, no ground. Coarse blocks, same tier arrangement from all five angles, no pine needles, conical smooth mesh or floating leaf cubes.
caption: Отдельный вариант дуба: пять ракурсов на белом фоне; без земли, площадки и ландшафта.
